learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected Both change and Lock it in. Earth initially 9.81 N, spring 1.00 kg, balance level.
observations.exploration: Moon changed pull to 1.62 N and spring to 0.17 kg while balance stayed level. Jupiter changed to 23.12 N and 2.36 kg while balance remained level. Show me why unlocked after Moon.
observations.reveal: Correct answer hanging spring reads less; explains equally shrinking balance arrows, unchanged mass, W = m g and Earth-calibrated bathroom scale reading about one sixth on Moon.
observations.visual: Inline screenshots inspected: spring stretched substantially on Jupiter, equal red downward arrows under both balance pans; bag remains labelled 1 kg. Orange active planet and numeric state legible.
observations.isolation: Evaluation preview no-history banner present. 7/7 claims checked chrome ignored.
references: CUA tab 543884107 snapshots and inline prediction/Jupiter screenshots, no screenshot file saved.
